sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Counsel for the petitioner is permitted to implead Senior Superintendent of Police, Meerut as respondent no. 3 in the writ petition.
Notice on behalf of newly impleaded respondent is accepted by learned Standing Counsel.

Petitioner's grievance in the writ petition with regard to illegal interference by the second respondent in running of his shop for which there is a valid licence issued under Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006 by the Government of Uttar Pradesh, Department of Food Safety and Drug Administration Food Safety and Standards Authority of India can always be accorded consideration Shahzad Saifi vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119992430/
1 by the third respondent.

entities.text: Department of Food Safety and Drug Administration Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Shahzad Saifi vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the nature of the order proposed to be passed, notices need not be issued to private respondent.

In the facts of the case, we permit the petitioner to approach the newly impleaded respondent i.e.
respondent no.3.

In view of the above, we dispose of this petition with a direction upon the respondent no. 3 to accord consideration to the petitioner's grievance, noticed above, and take an appropriate decision, in accordance with law, within a period of six weeks from the date of production of certified copy.

Order Date :- 17.3.2025 Mukesh  Shahzad Saifi vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119992430/
